title: Verschlimmbesserung: The Word Your Software Updates Need
summary: An article exploring the German term 'Verschlimmbesserung' - the phenomenon of making something worse while attempting to improve it - applied to software development and updates. The author discusses how well-intentioned code changes, refactoring, or feature additions often end up degrading user experience or introducing new bugs.
problem_solved: Addresses the common software engineering anti-pattern where updates and improvements inadvertently make products worse for users.
why_valuable: It provides valuable vocabulary and awareness to help developers recognize, discuss, and consciously avoid the trap of making improvements that ultimately harm the user experience.
